Great call — a couple quick clarifications from our side before we escalate to procurement/security: 

1) SOC 2: We need to see Type II or an in-flight Type II with a targeted completion date. Type I is acceptable for initial evaluation but procurement will require Type II prior to contract signature.

3) Key management: we prefer customer-managed keys where possible; however, procurement accepts cloud-provider KMS if the vendor can provide documented key rotation and limited operator access.

4) Questionnaire: forwarding our security-request-form.docx (attached) — please fill or provide answers in a short doc and send back.

We expect to share the procurement checklist with dates once we confirm Redwood's SOC 2 posture and roster.

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear ask, Mike — happy to confirm and provide the items requested. Short answers up front, details/attachments below.

SOC 2: Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type II (report issued Mar 2028). I will attach an executive summary and the auditor letter for procurement review. Full report is available under NDA; let us know if you want that and we'll route it.

HIPAA/BAA: We offer HIPAA controls and a BAA for customers processing PHI on our Hosted and Dedicated offerings. For EU PHI we recommend configuring regional clusters and applying our data residency guardrails (we will document the deployment details).

Subprocessors and data boundaries: Our canonical roster includes AWS (eu-west-1 / eu-west-2 for EU deployments), GCP (europe-west), Segment, Datadog, Sentry, Fastly (CDN), and HashiCorp Vault (secrets). Attached is the subprocessor roster CSV with region flags and control mappings. We can mark any that should be excluded or replaced for a custom deployment.

Key management: Hosted enterprise customers can use customer KMS (AWS KMS) for object encryption at rest. Dedicated and Private deployments support HSM/Bring-Your-Own-Key. We will include key-rotation docs and operator access controls in the package.

Questionnaire: I compiled answers to the questionnaire and included them as a PDF (answers_security_questionnaire.pdf). If you need more granular evidence (pen test reports, infra architecture), we can schedule a 45-minute architecture call.
